title: VTA WebVH DIDs Register-With-Server — payload
description: Hand an existing DID's log to a hosting server so it is served there.

force.description: Overwrite a registration the server already holds at this location. Default false: the location may be somebody else's identity.

domain.description: Domain to publish under, when the server serves more than one.

Response.title: VTA WebVH DIDs Register-With-Server — response payload

logEntryCount.description: Entries the server accepted. Compare it with the DID's own log length: a shorter count means the server holds a truncated history and will resolve to an older document.
